findings_as_matched.claim: The PR renames `Ordinal.IsNormal.mem_range_deriv` to `Ordinal.mem_range_deriv` but deletes the old name outright: the hunk that removed `theorem IsNormal.mem_range_deriv` put `alias IsNormal.fp_iff_deriv := fp_iff_deriv` in its place, and no `IsNormal.mem_range_deriv` alias exists anywhere. Every sibling that was renamed (`IsNormal.deriv_fp`, `IsNormal.le_iff_deriv`, `IsNormal.nfp_fp`, `IsNormal.apply_lt_nfp`, ...) got a deprecated alias. This one did not, so downstream code breaks with no deprecation warning.
